_how_to_use: DUMMY EXAMPLE: every value below is made up. Copy this file (e.g. my_profile.json), replace the values with your own, delete any field you don't know (never guess), then run: .venv/bin/python cli.py init --profile my_profile.json. Your real profile then lives in output/<your-name>/ (private, never uploaded). All fields: schemas/candidate_profile.schema.json. Richer example: examples/sample_candidate_full.json.
leadership_examples: Example: led a 4-person student team that built a campus app used by 500 students
